# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the series  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c16 P14](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0014), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew had an ungainly figure with stooping shoulders, long iron-gray hair, and a full, soft brown beard worn since he was twenty. He commonly wore his working clothes on the farm, but put on his best suit and a white collar when leaving Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Matthew was exceptionally shy and silent, dreading strangers and particularly women and little girls. He rarely volunteered information or engaged in conversation, preferring quiet, talkative people who required little response from him. Despite his extreme shyness, he possessed a gentle, sympathetic nature and a quiet, stubborn persistency when he set his mind on something.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026)_

- Farming and agricultural work  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c16 P14](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0014)</sub>

## Goals

- Keep Anne Shirley at Green Gables and ensure her happiness and care  <sub>[v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at Green Gables with his sister Marilla. When he was sixty, they decided to adopt an orphan boy to help with farm work, but due to a miscommunicated message, an eleven-year-old girl named Anne Shirley arrived at Bright River station instead. Driving her home to Green Gables, Matthew was quickly won over by her lively chatter and persuaded Marilla to keep her. He grew deeply attached to Anne, frequently indulging her and taking pride in her academic successes. Struggling with failing health, Matthew suffered a fatal heart attack after reading news of the Abbey Bank's failure, which wiped out his and Marilla's savings. He was buried in Avonlea, where Anne continued to visit his grave regularly to honor his memory.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c32 P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034), [v1 c36 P28](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0028), [v1 c36 P34](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0034), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021)_

## Background by volume

- Lived at the Green Gables homestead since his father established it  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Had worn a full brown beard continuously since the age of twenty  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Suffered long-term heart trouble  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c36 P28](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0028)</sub>
- Voted Conservative as a lifelong political conviction  <sub>[v1 c18 P9](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0009)</sub>
